title: Node fragment-control path calls LinkLayer.send twice
description: Security/correctness review finding in python/src/lichen/node.py: _process_received handles authenticated SCHC sender control with . The inner send returns bool, which is then passed as payload to a second send with missing required routing arguments. Any sender control response triggers TypeError after one attempted transmission, causing the receive loop to log and continue and breaking ACK/abort handling. Remove the nested send so each outgoing control is transmitted exactly once and add a regression proving one call with the intended payload/destination/priority.
close_reason: Invalidated during verification: current shared-worktree source has a single LinkLayer.send call; apparent nested call came from truncated/interleaved command output.
